channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News and other tool sources, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: GGfor Tools – free online tools for developers, designers & productivity
item.description: A one-stop box of free online tools — clean text, test regex, convert colors and units, all right in the browser.

item.title: Fairwind
item.description: List your activities and honors, have the teacher or coach who was there confirm each one, and share a single link on your college application so every entry is vouched for.

item.title: InayaFlow: AI TikTok Creator Assistant
item.description: Connect your TikTok account to analyze performance and get viral ideas, shooting scripts, and best posting times.

item.title: Spaceora: AI Home Design

item.title: Animate Old Photos

item.title: FileSwiss: Free, Private File Tools That Run 100% in Your Browser

item.title: Filemate Tools – 32 free online tools that run 100% in your browser
item.description: 32 free tools for PDF, images, text and developers that run entirely in your browser — no uploads, no sign-up.

item.title: AI Virtual Try-On

item.title: TarotPause
